reading: Rescuers in Nepal are trying to reach workers trapped at hydropower sites after severe flooding.
Mud has blocked tunnels where workers are believed to be trapped.
The rescue teams have used explosives to break through the hillside.
Engineers have also been pumping air into the tunnels.
Chinese and Nepalese military teams are leading the operation with help from international specialists.
One team entered a tunnel but withdrew after finding nobody inside.
Relatives of missing workers have called for the rescue to move faster.
